description: Upload the selected USD asset to Miris Spatial Streaming.
inputInstructions: Select the root USD file. Referenced layers and textures are packaged automatically. Leave both fields blank to use the VAMS asset name and no Miris tags.

tagSchema.label: Miris asset name
tagSchema.description: Name for the asset in Miris. Blank uses the VAMS asset name.

tagSchema.label: Miris tags
tagSchema.description: Tags to apply to the asset in Miris. Blank applies none.
